description: This file defines an abstract Java class `CredentialsApiAuthProvider` for implementing device authentication providers that verify device credentials against a Credentials API using tracing and Vert.x asynchronous patterns.

classes.name: CredentialsApiAuthProvider
classes.description: An abstract class providing authentication logic for device credentials via the Credentials API, including credential validation, tracing, and integration with Vert.x futures.

methods.name: getCredentialsClient
methods.description: Returns a Future containing the CredentialsClient for the specified tenant.

methods.name: getCredentialsForDevice
methods.description: Retrieves credentials stored on record for a given device using the Credentials API.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a device based on provided credentials, leveraging tracing and external Credentials API.

methods.name: validateCredentials
methods.description: Validates device credentials against credentials on record, including claims for equality and enabled status.

methods.name: doValidateCredentials
methods.description: Abstract method to implement specific credential validation logic.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a device using JSON-based credentials and tracing context.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Abstract method to create device credentials object from JSON authentication info.
